component.name: G-Toolbox
component.summary: Local AI and media toolkit that keeps your files on your computer

description.p: G-Toolbox is an all-in-one workspace for media, documents and local AI. Files are processed on your own computer: nothing is uploaded to a cloud service and no account is needed.

ul.li: Convert images, audio and video; make GIF/WebP clips; burn subtitles
Remove backgrounds, erase objects and upscale images with local AI models
Transcribe speech to text and subtitles, separate vocals and instruments
Clean photo metadata, merge and split PDFs, encrypt files with AES-256
Download videos, apply audio effects and reduce noise

description.p: The app runs in your web browser; a small window shows that it is running and stops it when closed. A phone can use the computer's power after a one-time pairing.
